summary: Six distinct Charlotte multifamily refinance opportunities qualify, all with active_confirmed debt, executed-note maturities between 2026-09-01 and 2027-08-31, no executed extensions, record owners verified 2026-08-10 and current Directors of Finance verified 2026-08-10. Ranked by maturity ascending then original principal descending: R1514 Alder Grove 1 (2027-01-15, $14.40M), R4598 Alder Park 3 (2027-03-15, $16.56M), R7567 Alder Square 4 (2027-04-15, $17.64M), R8446 Alder Grove 5 (2027-05-15, $18.72M, email null), R2663 Alder Grove 6 (2027-06-15, $19.80M), R3927 Alder Crossing 7 (2027-07-15, $20.88M). All loan amounts are original principal; outstanding balances are unpublished and reported as null (unknown, not zero). Excluded: released (R3086), status unknown (R2324), inferred/unconfirmed maturity (R2682, R6400), executed extension beyond window (R6902), maturity outside window (R8411), off-market/asset-type (R9859 Seattle, R3320 Office), manager-only owner (R5582), stale ownership (R4360), registered-agent-only contact (R2193), former employee contact (R1100), post-cutoff base publication (R6607). R6774 is eligible but deduplicated against R1514 (same entity/loan). Prospect CSV created at artifacts/prospects-v1.csv with the same facts and citations.
limitations: Outstanding balances are not published in any supplied extract; all are reported as null (unknown, not zero) and original principal must not be used as a proxy.

R4598 has a recorded release (U-R4598-2) published and effective 2026-09-10, i.e., after the 2026-08-31 evidence cutoff. Under the as-of-cutoff rule it does not control, but this lead will very likely be released/refinanced already and should be re-verified before outreach.
R7567's only newer document is an unsigned draft (U-R7567-3) proposing a 2028-01-01 maturity; if that draft is later executed, the record would fall outside the maturity window.
R6607 (Alder Park 18) would otherwise meet all criteria but its base extract postdates the cutoff (published 2026-09-03); it may qualify once evidence is refreshed.
Contact emails are as published in the base extracts; R8446 has no published email (null). No enrichment or verification beyond the supplied packet was performed.
Lender identity, interest rate, amortization, prepayment terms and property performance data are not supplied, so refinance sizing was not attempted.
Duplicate handling relies on matching entity_id/loan_id (R1514 vs R6774); no independent confirmation that these are the same underlying asset beyond the extract fields.
